AgeGroup.description: A node representing an age group in a search system.

Case.description: A node representing a case in a search system.

Drug.description: A node representing a drug in a search system.

Manufacturer.description: A node representing a manufacturer of cases.

Outcome.description: A node representing the outcome of a case.

Reaction.description: A reaction associated with a case.

ReportSource.description: A node representing a source of reports, with a unique code and name.

Therapy.description: A node representing a therapy session in a search system.

FALLS_UNDER.description: A relationship between a case and an age group, indicating that the case falls under the specified age group.

HAS_REACTION.description: A relationship indicating that a case has been reacted to.

IS_CONCOMITANT.description: A relationship indicating that a drug is concomitantly used with another drug in a case.

IS_PRIMARY_SUSPECT.description: A relationship indicating that a drug is the primary suspect in a case.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.description: A relationship indicating a secondary suspect in a case, connecting a drug to the case.

PRESCRIBED.description: A relationship between a therapy and a drug, indicating when the drug was prescribed.

RECEIVED.description: A relationship indicating that a case has received therapy.

REGISTERED.description: A relationship indicating that a manufacturer has registered a case.

REPORTED_BY.description: A relationship indicating that a case was reported by a specific source.

RESULTED_IN.description: A relationship indicating that a case resulted in an outcome.

AgeGroup.ageGroup.description: A string representing the age group, e.g., '18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+'

Case.reporterOccupation.description: The occupation of the person who reported the case.

Case.gender.description: The gender of the person who reported the case.

Case.eventDate.description: The date of the event that led to the case.

Case.reportDate.description: The date when the case was reported.

Case.primaryid.description: A unique identifier for the case.

Case.age.description: The age of the person who reported the case.

Case.ageUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the age of the person who reported the case.

Drug.name.description: The official name of the drug.

Outcome.outcome.description: The result or outcome of a case.

Outcome.code.description: A unique code associated with the outcome.

Reaction.description.description: A brief description of the reaction.

ReportSource.code.description: A unique identifier for the report source.

ReportSource.name.description: The name of the report source.

Therapy.primaryid.description: The unique identifier for the therapy session.

IS_CONCOMITANT.indication.description: The indication for the concomitant use of the drugs.

IS_CONCOMITANT.route.description: The route of administration for the concomitant use of the drugs.

IS_CONCOMITANT.doseAmount.description: The amount of the concomitant drug used.

IS_CONCOMITANT.doseUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the concomitant drug dose.

IS_CONCOMITANT.drugSequence.description: The order in which the drugs are administered.

IS_PRIMARY_SUSPECT.route.description: The route of administration of the drug.

IS_PRIMARY_SUSPECT.doseAmount.description: The amount of the drug administered.

IS_PRIMARY_SUSPECT.doseUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the drug dose.

IS_PRIMARY_SUSPECT.drugSequence.description: The sequence in which the drug was administered.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.indication.description: The indication for the drug in the case.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.doseAmount.description: The amount of the drug administered in the case.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.doseUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the dose of the drug in the case.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.drugSequence.description: The sequence of the drug in the case.

IS_SECONDARY_SUSPECT.route.description: The route of administration of the drug in the case.

PRESCRIBED.drugSequence.description: The sequence of drugs prescribed for the therapy.

PRESCRIBED.endYear.description: The year the drug was prescribed.

PRESCRIBED.startYear.description: The year the drug was prescribed.
